n1.text: Stop. Don't go in there yet. My party did.

n2.text: One goblin. Just one. It scattered all four of us. I don't know where they are.

choices.text: I don't know what to make.

n3.text: It sees well but not low. Stay crouched and it loses you.

n4.text: Take my scout's crossbow. He won't be needing it tonight. Mind the reload.
